journeyVersionSemantics.familyPurpose: A Goal Family groups Journeys that share the same user goal and diagnosis, and records the axis/question that distinguishes member Journeys.

architecture.expertRelationship: Journeys are linked to relevant Experts. The Career Expert diagnoses the appropriate Goal Family before Journey selection.
